"PROJECT: ULTIMATE FOOTBALL 2027

Act as a professional AAA football game developer, gameplay programmer, 3D artist, and UI/UX designer.

Create a highly realistic, immersive 3D football simulation game inspired by the gameplay quality and features of eFootball 2027.

The game must have original branding, original assets, and its own identity.

1. GRAPHICS AND VISUALS

- Realistic 3D football players.
- High-quality player faces and body animations.
- Realistic stadiums with thousands of spectators.
- Dynamic weather: rain, sunshine, and cloudy conditions.
- Day and night matches.
- Realistic grass, shadows, lighting, and ball physics.
- Cinematic camera angles and instant replays.
- Realistic player celebrations.

2. GAMEPLAY

Implement:

- Smooth passing and through balls.
- Short and long passes.
- Shooting with different power levels.
- Headers and volleys.
- Dribbling and skill moves.
- Sprinting and acceleration.
- Tactical defending and sliding tackles.
- Goalkeeper diving and saving animations.
- Player stamina and fatigue.
- Intelligent AI teammates and opponents.
- Realistic ball movement and collision physics.

3. GAME CONTROLS

Create an intuitive mobile control system:

LEFT SIDE:

- Virtual joystick for player movement.

RIGHT SIDE:

- Pass button.
- Through-pass button.
- Shoot button.
- Sprint button.
- Skill button.
- Tackle button.
- Switch-player button.

Allow customizable controls and button sizes.

4. GAME MODES

Include:

- Quick Match.
- Tournament.
- League Mode.
- Master League / Career Mode.
- Training Mode.
- Penalty Shootout.
- Local Multiplayer.
- Online Multiplayer.

5. TEAMS AND PLAYERS

Create a team selection screen featuring famous football clubs, including:

- Real Madrid.
- FC Barcelona.
- Manchester City.
- Liverpool.
- Bayern Munich.
- Paris Saint-Germain.
- Arsenal.
- Juventus.

Include player statistics:

- Speed.
- Shooting.
- Passing.
- Dribbling.
- Defending.
- Physical strength.

Allow users to create custom teams, formations, and tactics.

6. TACTICAL SYSTEM

Implement:

- 4-3-3.
- 4-4-2.
- 4-2-3-1.
- 3-5-2.
- Attacking and defensive strategies.
- Player substitutions.
- Team instructions.

7. MATCH PRESENTATION

Create a realistic football broadcast experience:

- Starting lineups.
- Stadium entrance.
- Referee and kickoff.
- Match timer and scoreboard.
- Player names and indicators.
- Half-time presentation.
- Final whistle.
- Match statistics.
- Goal replays.

8. SOUND

- Realistic stadium atmosphere.
- Crowd reactions.
- Referee whistle.
- Ball kicking sounds.
- Goal celebrations.
- Football commentary.

9. USER INTERFACE

Design a premium, modern football-game interface with:

- Animated menus.
- Team selection.
- Player cards.
- Formation editor.
- Match settings.
- Settings and graphics options.

10. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Build a fully playable prototype, not just a visual mockup.
- Use a suitable 3D game engine.
- Optimize performance for Android devices.
- Use modular, clean, maintainable code.
- Include responsive controls.
- Implement actual gameplay physics and AI.
- Provide clear setup and build instructions.

IMPORTANT:
Start by developing a fully playable 3D football match with two teams, a football, a stadium, working controls, intelligent opponents, goal detection, and a scoreboard.

Then expand the game into the other modes.

The final result should feel like a premium modern football simulation game.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

# TOUCHLINE — Football Club

An original, browser-playable 3D football prototype. The match is rendered in Three.js with an authored stadium, pitch markings, stands/crowd, simple animated player models, ball physics, AI positioning, goals, a broadcast scoreboard and keyboard/touch controls.

## Run locally

Requires Node.js 18+ and an internet connection for the Three.js CDN module and Google Fonts.

```sh
npm start
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). No install step or build is required.

## Play

- Select **PLAY MATCH** to enter a live match.
- Desktop: **WASD / arrow keys** move, **Shift** sprint, **F** shoot, **Space** pass, **G** through-pass, **E** switch player, **Q** tackle, **C** skill move, **Esc** pause.
- Mobile: left virtual joystick and right-side action buttons.
- The Clubs, Career, Training and Settings menu tabs provide prototype flows; Settings includes weather/day-night variants, and Clubs includes an original club plus inspired club-name placeholders.
- The match runs to six in-game minutes, tracks goals/shots and shows a full-time event.

## Scope

This is a fully playable small-scope prototype, not a commercial eFootball-scale production. It uses original Touchline branding and generated geometry, with no licensed player likenesses, club crests, commentary, external audio or downloaded assets. Teams, formations, online/local multiplayer, career progression, authentic professional animations, and advanced replay/stat systems are not implemented. The included player and crowd models are lightweight procedural stand-ins; visual quality depends on device/GPU. Three.js is loaded from jsDelivr.
